Project Manager
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a hands\-on **Project Manager** with experience in interior architecture, civil engineering or commercial construction.

You will manage commercial construction and improvement projects from start to finish, coordinate with contractors and vendors, conduct regular site visits, and ensure work is completed on time, within scope and to the required quality standards.

This is a field\-based role that requires regular travel

Key Responsibilities

* Plan project timelines, milestones and site activities.
* Conduct regular site visits and monitor progress.
* Check work against drawings, BOQs and specifications.
* Coordinate with architects, contractors and vendors.
* Provide clear progress updates to homeowners.
* Identify delays, quality issues and execution risks.
* Track materials, manpower and project dependencies.
* Document scope changes and their impact on cost and timelines.
* Resolve project issues and follow up until closure.
* Prepare snag lists and manage final project handover.
* Manage multiple residential projects at the same time.

Requirements

* Degree or Diploma in Interior , Architecture, Civil Engineering or a construction\-related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in residential /commercial construction, architecture, civil works, site management or project management.
* Good understanding of construction methods, drawings, BOQs and materials.
* Experience coordinating contractors, vendors and site teams.
* Strong communication skills in Malayalam and English.
* Good planning, problem\-solving and customer\-handling skills.
* Comfortable using a smartphone for calls, photographs, documentation and project updates.
* Valid driving licence required.
* Willingness to travel

Preferred Experience

Experience with architecture firms, residential /commercial construction companies, builders, contractors, developers or project management consultancies is preferred.

Candidates must have practical site experience. Applicants with only design experience and no construction\-site exposure may not be suitable for this role.

Pay: From ₹35,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Project and Operations Coordinator
description:
Wahni IT Solutions, an ERPNext implementation and technology solutions company based in Elamkulam, Kadavanthra, Ernakulam, is looking for a project and operations coordinator to ensure process adherence across our Sales, Project Delivery, and Support teams.

The ideal candidate should be detail\-oriented, organized, proactive, and good at coordination and follow\-up. This role also provides an opportunity to learn ERPNext, business processes, and ERP implementation, with potential career growth into an ERP Project / Functional Consultant role.

**Key Responsibilities**

\* Monitor compliance with company processes, checklists, and procedures.

\* Ensure timely completion of documents, approvals, checklists, and handovers.

\* Identify process gaps, deviations, and missing documentation.

\* Follow up with teams on pending activities and ensure timely closure.

\* Maintain compliance trackers and prepare periodic reports.

\* Coordinate between Sales, Project, Technical, and Support teams.

\* Support continuous process and quality improvement.

\* Develop knowledge of ERPNext and ERP implementation.

**Eligibility \& Skills**

\* MBA graduates / Freshers are encouraged to apply.

\* Graduates from Management, Commerce, BCA/MCA, Engineering, or related fields.

\* Good knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and documentation tools.

\* Strong communication, analytical, organizational, and follow\-up skills.

\* Ability to take ownership and work across multiple teams.

\* Experience in process coordination, QA, auditing, or documentation is an advantage but not mandatory.

\* Knowledge of ERPNext, ERP systems, or Agile/Scrum is a plus.

\* Candidates from Kerala are preferred.

**What We Offer**

\* Competitive salary and employee benefits.

\* Health insurance.

\* Hands\-on exposure to ERPNext projects and real\-world business processes.

\* Career growth opportunities towards ERP Project / Functional Consulting.

\* Collaborative and learning\-oriented work environment.

**If you are detail\-oriented and interested in building a career in ERP and Functional Consulting, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now!**

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a highly organized and proactive **Project Coordinator** to support the planning, coordination, and successful execution of projects. The ideal candidate will coordinate with internal teams, clients, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and according to quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate day\-to\-day project activities and ensure smooth project execution.
* Prepare project schedules, action plans, meeting agendas, and status reports.
* Track project timelines, milestones, deliverables, and deadlines.
* Coordinate with project managers, team members, clients, vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Follow up with team members on assigned tasks and ensure timely completion.
* Maintain project documentation, records, trackers, and reports.
* Organize project meetings and prepare meeting minutes and action points.
* Monitor project progress and highlight delays, risks, or issues to the Project Manager.
* Assist in resource planning, material coordination, and vendor follow\-ups.
* Support preparation of quotations, purchase requests, invoices, and other project\-related documents when required.
* Maintain effective communication between different departments involved in the project.
* Ensure project activities are carried out according to company procedures and requirements.
* Assist the Project Manager with administrative and operational tasks.
* Prepare regular project updates for management and clients.

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

**Job Description**

**We are looking for Project Managers, Incharges, Engineer to manage and support the execution of residential and commercial construction projects. The candidate will be responsible for site coordination, quality control, and ensuring works are executed as per approved drawings, specifications, and timelines.**

**The ideal candidate should be technically sound, proactive, and capable of coordinating between site teams, consultants, vendors, and the office.**

**Key Responsibilities**

Manage day\-to\-day site execution activities as per approved drawings and specifications

Read, understand, and interpret architectural, structural, and MEP drawings

Coordinate with site supervisors, contractors, and labour teams

Ensure quality control and adherence to construction standards

Monitor work progress and update the project schedule

Coordinate material requirements, procurement, and site inventory

Conduct site measurements and assist in billing and BOQ verification

Daily progress and issues to the Project Manager / Office

Coordinate with consultants and clients during inspections and reviews

**Key Requirements**

B.Tech / BE /Diploma in Civil Engineering

2–10 years of relevant experience in building construction

Strong knowledge of site execution and construction practices

Ability to read and execute works from drawings

Good coordination and communication skills

Willingness to work at site locations

Experience in residential or commercial projects.
